Figures are the 13 Oct production runs' own. pause = [word, seconds]: silence added inside the take after that word (parts.PAUSE, mix.voice). Cut 4 drops the agents' four lines for g01, Rehearsal's m01, and the end's e01 for e02, and adds the console's live view (k03) and Impact's ledger (m10). take = the line's chosen take by name (pick.py), where the best-scoring take ran its phrases together.

lines.text: Every day, India's food brands write off stock that sells too slowly.
Too close to its date for quick commerce, it is destroyed, and its GST credit reversed.
Smart-Clearance turns that write-off into recovery.
It is software as a service for FMCG brands: each gets its own workspace, where AI agents find the best exit for every pack at risk.
Ten agents on Gemini walk every batch through nine stops, to one human yes.
Here's what you'll see, live on production: the SaaS console, a happy path, and a sad path.
In the console, Neha sets up a brand in minutes: its stock export mapped, its people invited.
Each SKU gets its own quick-commerce gates, and every agent acts, asks, or only suggests.
Then she watches every client live: the batches in flight, the agents at work, and what they recover.
Everyone signs in on their own device, to the real apps on Cloud Run, with agents reasoning on Gemini.
Priya, in supply chain, gets the Watcher's alert: Munchly's Mango Drink in Hyderabad, twenty-two days left, twenty-two thousand rupees at stake.
At the godown, Lakshmi Agencies photographs the label. Vision reads its batch, dates and FSSAI licence, and matches them to the stock export.
The Valuer prices every exit, and the Router splits the batch. Priya approves the plan with one tap.
Outreach offers the packs to fifty-eight kiranas in their own language. A shopkeeper orders on her phone, and it lands on Priya's screen, live.
Next on our roadmap: more Indian languages, and WhatsApp.
Fifty-two shops take thirteen hundred and seventy-two packets, and every order gets its own GST invoice.
The godown's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs, each paying by scanning Lakshmi Agencies' UPI code, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.
Feeding India collects the last fifty-eight packs, and issues a donation receipt.
Paperwork drafts every paper. Munchly recovers nearly seventeen thousand rupees, and Lakshmi Agencies ends whole.
Lakshmi Agencies sees it all on her own portal: every step, and every paper.
But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' kiranas in Nagpur, and just two of them order.
lines.say: But not every batch sells. Munch-lee's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' kiranas in Nagpur, and just two of them order.

lines.text: On ExpireSoon, a wholesaler in Raipur bids thirteen rupees; the Negotiator counters at fourteen twenty, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs sell.
Five hundred and forty packets are left when the window closes.
On expiry day, Rakesh must destroy them through an authorised agency, and prove it.
At the landfill he photographs it, and the agency's officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate on his tablet.
Vision checks the photos; only on Priya's second yes are the certificate and credit note issued, every paper signed.
Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and Rakesh ends whole.
lines.say: Even here, Munch-lee recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and Rakesh ends whole.

lines.text: Impact posts it to the ledger: two point three tonnes of food kept out of landfill this year, ready for BRSR.
Smart-Clearance. Ten agents, one yes, and nothing good goes to waste.
